description: This header defines the absl::BitGenRef class, a type-erasing, non-owning reference interface for various uniform random bit generators (URBGs), supporting both Abseil and standard library generators. It includes internal type traits, mock support, and example usage.

classes.name: BitGenRef
classes.description: A type-erasing, non-owning reference class for any uniform random bit generator (URBG), supporting both Abseil and standard library generators.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random uint64_t value using the stored generator.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the result type.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the result type.
